assets.name: home-airpods-art
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a completely new premium editorial illustration for the SimpleMemo Japanese homepage's AirPods voice capture feature. Landscape 3:2 composition, no text anywhere: all Japanese explanatory copy will be real HTML beside this image. A beautifully realistic pair of white AirPods Pro wireless earbuds, floating as a clean studio product still life above a matte near-black surface. A single restrained sculptural lavender sound-wave ribbon passes between them, resolving into a small elegant white paper note and a translucent violet faceted crystal in the lower right, symbolic of capturing voice to notes. Palette strictly near-black #0b0912, ivory white, muted lavender #c4b5fd and rich violet. Soft directional studio light, tactile matte background, elegant reflections on the white earbuds, soft grounded shadows. Spacious composition with generous breathing room and nothing cut off. Sophisticated, quiet, distinctive, warm editorial art direction matching a black/violet/white website. No letters, no numbers, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no phone screens or interface, no invented controls. Avoid neon cyberpunk, busy light trails, sparkles, cyan, clutter or gratuitous decorative objects. It should look like commissioned campaign artwork, not a generic tech stock image. Opaque background.

assets.name: home-tags-art
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a completely new premium editorial illustration for SimpleMemo's on-device automatic memo tagging feature. Landscape 3:2 image, absolutely no text: all Japanese explanatory copy is provided as live HTML beside the image. An elegant physical still life of three small ivory paper memo sheets floating above a dark matte surface. The first sheet has a subtle embossed sound waveform, the next has a few minimal embossed horizontal lines, the last has two small beautifully crafted translucent lavender luggage-tag shapes resting against it. This is an abstract visual metaphor for voice becoming an organized note, not an app screen or literal product interface. A small violet faceted crystal in the background connects this to Obsidian. Tactile paper, precise beveled glass details, quiet photographic studio lighting, slight perspective from above, clear structured composition, generous breathing room. Match a restrained premium black/violet/white brand: near-black #0b0912, ivory white, muted lavender #c4b5fd, deep violet shadows. No literal letters, words, numbers, hashtags, AI robot, brain, sparkle icon, cloud/server, lock, logos, watermark, neon, cyan, busy particles, computer or phone mockup. Objects fully in frame. Opaque background.
